Installs cleanly over v1.5.3 (versionName 1.5.4-beta, versionCode 96), signed
with the same CN=Kuro Anime release key so no uninstall is needed. Public GitHub

What is new in 1.5.4-beta
  1. Cinematic Title Detail Page v2 (#2).
     - Full-bleed banner header with ★ AniList score, runtime, format, status,
       studio, and SUB/DUB pills.
     - Interactive Franchise & Watch-Order pill strip (Prequels -> Current ✓ ->
       Sequels / Movies / OVAs) to jump across seasons in one tap.
     - Canon / Filler / Recap episode badges (combining live HiAnime filler
       markers, episode recap heuristics, and curated long-runner ranges) plus a
       persistent "Skip Filler" pill switch that hides filler/recap rows AND
       skips past them automatically on Auto-Next & Fullscreen Next Episode.
     - Upgraded 16:9 episode thumbnail rows with saved playhead progress bars.
     - One-tap "⬇ Batch Download" modal sheet (Next 3 / 5 / 12 / All unwatched
       up to 24) resolving verified Zenkai direct HLS streams into Kuro offline
       storage (with automatic Watch Queue fallback for embed-only sources).

  2. Widescreen Left-Rail Leanback UI & Glowing DPAD Focus (#3 — Desktop site ON only).
     - Strictly gated on Settings -> Appearance and startup -> Site view -> Desktop.
     - Default Mobile mode keeps the standard mobile top bar and bottom 5-tab dock
       100% unchanged.
     - Turning Desktop site ON switches to a frosted-OLED left navigation rail,
       1180px widescreen layout viewport, widescreen hero & landscape Continue
       Watching rail, multi-column grids, glowing accent DPAD spatial arrow-key
       focus navigation, ContextMenu/F2 poster quick actions, and a contextual
       "OK Select · MENU Quick Actions · ESC Back" pill (plus a one-tap "Mobile ↺"
       switch at the foot of the rail).

  3. Smart Multi-Filter Browse & Voice Command Search (#4).
     - Combinable OLED filter pills on Browse: Dub Available, CC Subbed, ★ 8.0+,
       ★ 8.5+, Airing, Completed, and top Genres alongside Format & Year chips.
     - Native Android Voice Search mic button (RecognizerIntent, zero RECORD_AUDIO
       permission required, with Web Speech fallback) right in the Browse bar.
     - "🎲 Surprise Me" randomizer pill.
     - Richer poster badges with top-right ★ scores and bottom-left SUB | DUB
       split count pills.
